fields.description: Hours required for Present attendance. Below this (but > 0) is Half Day.

fields.description: Email paid employees who have not submitted a Daily Work Log for the previous working day. Skips holidays, weekly offs, approved leave, and anyone who already logged.
fields.label: Enable Morning Missing-Log Reminder

fields.description: Hour of day in site timezone (0–23). Scheduler checks hourly and sends only at this hour.
fields.label: Reminder Hour

fields.description: Optional. Blank = system default outgoing email.
fields.label: Reminder Send From (email)

fields.description: Send a summary of everyone's work logs (hours, projects, tasks, missing logs) by email.
fields.label: Enable Work Log Summary Email

fields.description: Daily = yesterday. Weekly = previous Mon–Sun (sent Monday). Monthly = previous month (sent on the 1st).
fields.label: Frequency

fields.description: Optional. Sender address (must be a configured outgoing account). Blank = system default outgoing email.
fields.label: Send From (email)

fields.description: Optional. One role per line, in addition to employees on the Executive Board / Board of Directors grades, who always receive the summary.
fields.label: Recipient Roles

fields.description: Optional extra addresses (comma or newline separated), in addition to the roles above.
fields.label: Extra Recipient Emails
